description: A flame-forged sentinel who bathed in the magma of Embercradle to harden their body into living volcanic rock. They draw enemy fury and answer it with burning vengeance.
icon_hint: molten iron shield engulfed in roaring orange flames with ember core
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy pyrewarden flame tank class in a volcanic wasteland. Cracked obsidian border with glowing orange lava seeping through cracks and ember sparks at corners. Dark volcanic rock center with pulsing orange-red magma veins. Small molten shield silhouette at bottom. Color palette: obsidian black, molten red, ember orange. No characters, no text.
